# Targeted station cards — Unit3 week15
A: predict mapping trace; compare counts.copy() with shared nested list values. Repair grid=[[0]*3]*2 so rows are independent. Show state before/after one mutation and explain the references.
B: quantity-sort X03:4,X01:2,X02:4 by insertion, then trace bubble and selection using the earlier sorting examples. Explain stability differences for the specific implementations. Complete starter functions; test empty/one/first/last/absent. Explain why quantity order is not an ID search precondition.
C: identify inherited versus overridden behaviour in Camera/Projector; demonstrate polymorphic calls. Use existing project tests: rejected loan leaves stock unchanged; repeated return does not restore twice. Document expected/actual and one regression requirement for a message change. Use synthetic records.
D: host 192.168.60.130/28, destination .145: calculate mask/network/broadcast/range/capacity/gateway and local/routed decision. Count 9endpoints+gateway; justify smallest ordinary LAN prefix. Trace remote IP/gateway MAC without NAT. Contrast IPv6 host-allocation reasoning.
E: routed Staff/Visitors VLANs without filtering; identify the missing control and positive/negative tests plus DNS/DHCP dependencies.16 clients x6 Mbit/s versus 100 Mbit/s;300 MB at 80 Mbit/s. Explain overhead/other bottlenecks. Interpret ping-success/web-failure and unanswered-middle-hop/later-response. Redraw with specified Cisco symbols.
At each station: unaided attempt -> correction -> different-value retry. One programming and one networking station are required, not all five rotations in one lesson.
